validationTargets.browserSendBody: validate only the exact matching event content schema; request path supplies room/event type; no freshness decision is made
validationTargets.serverEvent: validate the exact server envelope plus recursively validated content; freshness uses origin_server_ts

dsl.matrix-device-id: nonempty string up to 255 code units
dsl.unpadded-base64: canonical unpadded RFC4648 standard Base64 (alphabet A-Za-z0-9+/, no whitespace or equals padding; decode then re-encode must be identical)
dsl.unpadded-base64-public-ephemeral: exactly 32 decoded bytes of unpadded-base64 encoding of a public ephemeral key; never a private key
dsl.unpadded-base64-mac: exactly 32 decoded bytes of unpadded-base64 protocol MAC output; never a derived displayed SAS value
dsl.ordered-subset:A,B: nonempty array containing only A or B, no duplicates, order preserved
dsl.object-of-key-id-to-unpadded-base64-mac: nonempty object; keys are Matrix key IDs; values are unpadded-base64; no prototype/unknown metadata keys
dsl.standard-human-fallback-only: exact string: <expected sender Matrix user ID> + ' is requesting to verify your key, but your client does not support in-chat key verification. You will need to use legacy key verification to verify keys.'

optional.room_id: matrix-room-id when the response shape omits it and capture context supplies the exact room

forbiddenValueMatching: case-sensitive UTF-8 substring search over every decoded string plus raw-byte search; runtime adds the live chat canary, planted scanner marker, exact displayed SAS decimal strings, emoji glyphs, and emoji labels; expected sender is supplied independently from validated operation context, never inferred from fallback body

required.reason: UTF-8 string 1..256 code units with no control characters
